meta.title: Shop platform overview
meta.description: The storefront at a glance; open Payments or Search for the detail.

summary.headline: One gateway in front of three services; Payments and Search each have their own detail diagram.
points: Every client request passes the API gateway
Orders drives checkout and calls Payments synchronously
Search is fed by catalogue events, never by direct writes
Cards with a magnifier open a detail diagram (D or double-click)

data.title: API gateway
data.subtitle: Auth, rate limits, routing
data.description: Terminates TLS, checks the session token and routes each request to its service.

data.title: Search
data.subtitle: Product search and filters
data.description: Answers product queries from its own index. Open the detail diagram to see how the index is kept fresh.

data.title: Orders
data.subtitle: Carts, checkout, order state
data.description: Owns the order lifecycle and publishes an event for every state change.

data.title: Payments
data.subtitle: Authorise and capture
data.description: Takes card payments for Orders. Open the detail diagram for fraud checks, the provider and the ledger.

steps.title: Overview
steps.description: Six parts. Search and Payments carry a magnifier: each opens its own detail diagram.

steps.title: Find the product
steps.description: The web shop sends the query through the gateway to Search.

steps.title: Check out
steps.description: The gateway routes the checkout to Orders, which creates the order.

steps.title: Take the payment
steps.description: Orders asks Payments to charge the card. Open Payments to follow the charge inside it.

steps.title: Publish and reindex
steps.description: The paid order goes onto the event bus; Search picks up stock changes from it.

meta.title: Payments service
meta.description: How a charge is checked, authorised and recorded.

data.title: Fraud check
data.subtitle: Scores every charge
data.description: Blocks charges that score above the risk threshold before they reach the provider.

steps.title: Inside Payments
steps.description: Four parts: the API, the fraud check, the card provider and the ledger.

steps.title: Score the charge
steps.description: The API sends the charge to the fraud check first.

steps.title: Authorise
steps.description: A charge that passes is authorised with the card provider.

steps.title: Record it
steps.description: The capture result is written to the ledger as two entries.

meta.title: Search service
meta.description: How queries are answered and the index is kept fresh.

steps.title: Inside Search
steps.description: Reads go to the index; writes arrive only as events.

steps.title: Answer a query
steps.description: The Query API searches the product index and ranks the hits.

steps.title: Consume an event
steps.description: The indexer reads the next catalogue event from the bus.

steps.title: Update the index
steps.description: The indexer upserts the changed product, so the next query sees it.
